issues.description: The problem statement and tests expect public getters for each attribute (e.g., getLectureName(), getNumberOfInscribedStudents()), but the provided solution implements getLectureName() and getNumberOfInscribedStudents() as private. This visibility mismatch will prevent students (and automated tests) from accessing these getters and contradicts the exercise requirement to implement getters for each attribute.
issues.suggestedFix: Make all attribute getters public to match the specification and tests. Specifically, change getLectureName() and getNumberOfInscribedStudents() from private to public so that every attribute has a public getter as described in the problem statement.
